critical.issue: TypeError: can't subtract offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes at routers/driver.py:311 (_cancellation_outcome). _parse('2026-08-02 09:00') returns naive datetime while now_utc() is aware. Any driver cancel with a naive pickup_at (which is the default format the wizard sends) crashes with 500. This is exactly the same lifecycle path the user is testing → must be fixed. Suggested: in _parse, if tzinfo is None assume UTC (dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)).

rca_of_issue: Driver cancel 500 RCA: _parse() uses datetime.fromisoformat which preserves naive/aware from the input string. Wizards & clients store pickup_at as 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM' (no offset) → naive. now_utc() returns timezone-aware datetime. The subtraction in _cancellation_outcome (driver.py:311) raises TypeError. Mitigation: coerce parsed dt to UTC when tzinfo is None, OR store pickup_at always in isoformat with 'Z'.
